svg.title: Recognition with a supplied occlusion mask
svg.desc: Three panels show a learned T template, a scene with a hidden section, and the matching cells recovered by the probe. A table compares ordinary overlap with visibility-aware overlap.
svg.text: Finding a part behind an occluder
The comparator receives a known visibility mask and the returning reference wave.
The intact scene passes both methods. Both abstain on heavy occlusion, an L distractor and a shortened-T lookalike.
Gating C at the comparator silences the 58° match. The reference returns after 8,597 ticks.
